When b = a, γd is continuous (from hγ), so its support is open (`Continuous.isOpen_support`, the to_additive form of `Continuous.isOpen_mulSupport`). An open subset of the slice {p | p.1 = a} is empty, since a point p in it would also put (p.1+ε, p.2) in it; so γd = 0. With γd = 0, everything collapses by unfolding definitions: weightedSource 0 = p.1 * 0 = 0; normalizeSource d a 0 = sourceMultiplier • 0 = 0; pastIntegral and totalIntegral of 0 are integrals of 0, so compactIntegral χ M v 0 = 0 - χ • 0 = 0; pullback d a 0 = 0, hence physicalCompact … = 0; divideRadius 0 = 0 / p.1 = 0, so streamPotential … = 0. Then graphDz w 0 = fderiv ℝ 0 p (0,w) = 0 and graphDr k v 0 = 0, so streamBeta w 0 = -0 = 0 and streamGamma k v 0 = 0 + 0 = 0. Hence graphDivergence … p = 0 + 0/p.1 + 0 = 0 for every p, including p.1 = 0. Proof without hab: split on `a < b`; in that case use the existing proof unchanged (ha, hd, hγ, hs are still available); otherwise derive γd = 0 as above and close the goal by simp after unfolding.
